pillar.working_title_ar: تعليم الأسماء والذكاء الاصطناعي: من الرمز إلى العالم والمسؤولية
pillar.working_title_en: Teaching the Names and Artificial Intelligence: From Symbols to World Models and Responsibility

thematic_origin.work: قل سيروا في الأرض فانظروا كيف بدأ الخلق

source_policy.religious: Qur'anic text and original exegetical works are primary; later summaries cannot replace the original interpretive passages.
source_policy.technical: Central empirical claims require original papers or official proceedings; reviews may map a dispute but cannot alone support a specific experimental result.
source_policy.frontier: Unreviewed preprints may identify open questions but cannot carry the central conclusion without replication and explicit labelling.
excluded: company marketing pages as proof of understanding
news coverage as evidence for technical claims
model self-reports as evidence of consciousness
benchmark leaderboards without task design and error analysis
the author's book as scientific evidence
citation count as a substitute for methodological fit

claims.claim_ar: مشهد تعليم الأسماء جزء من حجة الخلافة وحدود العلم في البقرة 30–33، وليس قصة معزولة عن الفساد والمسؤولية.
claims.claim_en: The teaching-of-the-names scene belongs to the argument about vicegerency and creaturely epistemic limits in Qur'an 2:30–33, not to an isolated naming story.
claims.limit_ar: لا يحول السياق الآيات إلى نظرية سياسية أو معرفية حديثة مكتملة.
claims.limit_en: The context does not turn the passage into a complete modern political or cognitive theory.

claims.claim_ar: اختلف المفسرون في نطاق الأسماء وطبيعتها: أسماء الأشياء أو طوائف منها، أو المسميات، أو الصفات والخواص، أو ملكة التسمية؛ لذلك لا توجد قراءة تقنية حديثة وحيدة يفرضها النص.
claims.claim_en: Exegetes differed over the range and nature of the names—names of things or selected beings, referents, properties, or a naming capacity—so the passage does not mandate one modern technical reading.
claims.limit_ar: الخلاف لا يعني أن كل قراءة معاصرة صحيحة أو متساوية.
claims.limit_en: Interpretive diversity does not make every contemporary reading equally valid.

claims.claim_ar: الآيات تعرض علمًا مُعلَّمًا وحدًا لعلم المخلوق؛ ولا تثبت أن كل نظام يستعمل الأسماء يشارك الإنسان منزلته أو تكليفه.
claims.claim_en: The passage presents taught knowledge and limits on creaturely knowledge; it does not imply that every system using names shares human status or moral obligation.
claims.limit_ar: هذا استنتاج عقدي/تفسيري للمؤلف، لا نتيجة تجربة في الذكاء الاصطناعي.
claims.limit_en: This is the author's theological-exegetical synthesis, not an AI experiment.

claims.claim_ar: هدف التدريب التنبؤي يحدد دالة التحسين، لكنه لا يحسم وحده نوع البنى الداخلية التي قد يتعلمها النموذج.
claims.claim_en: A predictive training objective specifies the optimization target but does not by itself determine every internal structure the model may learn.
claims.limit_ar: وجود بنية داخلية لا يثبت أنها مستقرة أو معممة أو ذات معنى خارجي.
claims.limit_en: Internal structure does not establish stability, generality, or external reference.

claims.claim_ar: الخلاف بين الشكل والمعنى لا يحسم بشعار: النص وحده يواجه مشكلة تأريض قوية، لكن علاقات الدور المفهومي قد تحمل جوانب حقيقية من المعنى.
claims.claim_en: The form–meaning dispute cannot be settled by slogan: text-only learning faces a serious grounding challenge, while conceptual-role relations may still encode genuine aspects of meaning.
claims.limit_ar: لا يوجد تعريف وحيد متفق عليه للمعنى أو الفهم في هذه الأدبيات.
claims.limit_en: The literature has no single agreed definition of meaning or understanding.

claims.claim_ar: في مهام محددة، تعلمت نماذج تسلسلية تمثيلات منتظمة لحالة لعبة أو للمكان والزمان يمكن فكها من التنشيطات الداخلية.
claims.claim_en: In bounded tasks, sequence models have learned structured representations of game state, space, or time that can be decoded from internal activations.
claims.limit_ar: نجاح المسبار قد يكشف معلومة متاحة من غير أن يثبت أن النموذج يستعملها سببيًا.
claims.limit_en: Probe success may reveal available information without proving causal use.

claims.claim_ar: التدخل السببي على التمثيلات يقدم دليلًا أقوى من الارتباط وحده على أن البنية الداخلية تؤدي وظيفة في الحساب.
claims.claim_en: Causal interventions on representations provide stronger evidence than correlation alone that an internal structure participates in computation.
claims.limit_ar: حتى التدخل الناجح محلي للنموذج والمهمة ولا يثبت فهمًا عامًا.
claims.limit_en: Even a successful intervention is local to a model and task and does not establish general understanding.

claims.claim_ar: قد تنهار نتائج مرتفعة تحت تغييرات صغيرة تحفظ المحتوى، مثل طول الخيارات أو نوع المسألة أو استبدال أسماء غير مؤثرة، مما يكشف اعتمادًا على اختصارات سطحية.
claims.claim_en: High scores can collapse under small content-preserving changes such as option length, problem format, or irrelevant noun replacement, revealing shortcut dependence.
claims.limit_ar: لا يعني الفشل في benchmark واحد غياب كل تمثيل مجرد.
claims.limit_en: Failure on one benchmark does not imply the absence of every abstract representation.

claims.claim_ar: التعميم التركيبي ليس قدرة مضمونة؛ تظهر النماذج نجاحات جزئية وفجوات منتظمة عند النقل إلى تركيبات أو رتب أو جذور جديدة.
claims.claim_en: Compositional generalization is not guaranteed: models show partial successes and systematic gaps under novel combinations, orders, or roots.
claims.limit_ar: تختلف النتيجة باختلاف النموذج والتدريب والمهمة وطريقة القياس.
claims.limit_en: Results depend on model, training, task, and metric.

claims.claim_ar: دمج الرؤية والحالة الحسية والفعل يضيف روابط بالعالم لا يملكها النموذج النصي وحده، لكنه لا يحسم القصد أو الخبرة الذاتية.
claims.claim_en: Vision, sensor state, and action add world-linked evidence unavailable to text-only models, without settling intention or subjective experience.
claims.limit_ar: الأداء الروبوتي في مجموعات مهام محددة لا يساوي تأريضًا مفتوحًا شبيهًا بالإنسان.
claims.limit_en: Robotic task performance is not equivalent to open-ended human-like grounding.

claims.claim_ar: اختبار تورنغ يجعل السلوك اللغوي معيارًا تشغيليًا قابلًا للملاحظة، لكنه لا يحسم بمفرده طبيعة الحالات الداخلية أو الوعي.
claims.claim_en: Turing's imitation game supplies an observable operational criterion for linguistic behavior but does not by itself settle internal state or consciousness.
claims.limit_ar: يجب تمثيل اختبار تورنغ كما صاغه لا كاختبار بسيط لنجاح محادثة قصيرة.
claims.limit_en: Turing's proposal must not be reduced to a short chatbot conversation.

claims.claim_ar: حجة الغرفة الصينية تعترض على كفاية تنفيذ برنامج لإنتاج القصد الداخلي؛ وهي اعتراض فلسفي مؤثر لا نتيجة تجريبية نهائية.
claims.claim_en: The Chinese Room challenges the sufficiency of program execution for intrinsic intentionality; it is an influential philosophical argument, not a final empirical result.
claims.limit_ar: لا يجوز تقديم الحجة بوصفها إجماعًا أو برهانًا مختبريًا على استحالة الفهم الآلي.
claims.limit_en: The argument is neither consensus nor a laboratory proof that machine understanding is impossible.

claims.claim_ar: الأدق تحليل الفهم عبر ست طبقات مستقلة نسبيًا: تمييز الرمز، انتظام العلاقات، التركيب، التأريض، النموذج السببي، والقصد/المسؤولية، مع فصل الوعي كسؤال إضافي.
claims.claim_en: Understanding is better analyzed across six partly independent layers—symbol discrimination, relational structure, composition, grounding, causal world-model use, and intention/responsibility—with consciousness treated separately.
claims.limit_ar: المصفوفة إطار تحليلي غير مصدق وليست مقياسًا للوعي أو اختبارًا وحيدًا للفهم.
claims.limit_en: The matrix is an unvalidated analytical framework, not a consciousness scale or single test of understanding.

claims.claim_ar: صلة تعليم الأسماء بالذكاء الاصطناعي صلة سؤال أخلاقي ومعرفي عن العلم والمسؤولية، لا مطابقة بين الوحي وبنية Transformer أو هدف التدريب.
claims.claim_en: The connection between teaching the names and AI is an epistemic and ethical comparison about knowledge and responsibility, not an identity between revelation and Transformer architecture or training objectives.
claims.limit_ar: لا يمنع هذا الحد استخدام العلم الحديث في التدبر المقارن إذا وُسمت الحدود بوضوح.
claims.limit_en: This boundary does not forbid disciplined comparative reflection when limits are explicit.

sources.title: Qur'an 2:30–33
sources.role: Defines the complete textual unit: vicegerency, the angels' question, taught names, epistemic confession, and Adam's disclosure.

sources.author: Muhammad ibn Jarir al-Tabari
sources.title: Jami al-Bayan, commentary on Qur'an 2:31
sources.role: Documents early interpretive diversity, al-Tabari's grammatical preference, and the passage's epistemic rebuke.

sources.author: Abu Abd Allah al-Qurtubi
sources.title: Al-Jami li-Ahkam al-Qur'an, commentary on Qur'an 2:31
sources.role: Distinguishes name, naming expression, and referent and surveys interpretive and grammatical issues.

sources.author: Muhammad al-Tahir ibn Ashur
sources.title: Al-Tahrir wa al-Tanwir, commentary on Qur'an 2:31
sources.role: Connects teaching and Adam's aptitude to the detailed wisdom of vicegerency.

sources.author: Fakhr al-Din al-Razi
sources.title: Mafatih al-Ghayb, commentary on Qur'an 2:31
sources.role: Presents the reading of names as properties, attributes, or realities and contrasts it with the conventional reading.

sources.author: Al-Raghib al-Isfahani
sources.title: Mufradat Alfaz al-Qur'an, entry on knowledge/teaching
sources.role: Links teaching the names to a divinely given capacity for articulation and naming.

sources.author: A. M. Turing
sources.title: Computing Machinery and Intelligence
sources.role: Replaces an ambiguous metaphysical question with an operational imitation-game question and discusses objections.

sources.author: John R. Searle
sources.title: Minds, Brains, and Programs
sources.role: Challenges the sufficiency of program execution for intrinsic intentionality.

sources.author: Stevan Harnad
sources.title: The Symbol Grounding Problem
sources.role: Formulates the problem of intrinsic semantic interpretation and proposes grounding in non-symbolic representations.

sources.author: Ashish Vaswani et al.
sources.title: Attention Is All You Need
sources.role: Defines the Transformer architecture; it does not itself make a philosophical claim of understanding.

sources.author: Tom B. Brown et al.
sources.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
sources.role: Documents autoregressive language-model scaling and broad zero/few-shot performance with limitations.

sources.author: Emily M. Bender and Alexander Koller
sources.title: Climbing towards NLU: On Meaning, Form, and Understanding in the Age of Data
sources.role: States the strongest form–meaning objection to text-only training.

sources.author: Yonatan Bisk et al.
sources.title: Experience Grounds Language
sources.role: Develops a physical and social grounding research agenda beyond text-only representation learning.

sources.author: Brenden M. Lake and Marco Baroni
sources.title: Generalization without Systematicity: On the Compositional Skills of Sequence-to-Sequence Recurrent Networks
sources.role: Introduces controlled tests showing failure under systematic compositional splits.

sources.author: Steven T. Piantadosi and Felix Hill
sources.title: Meaning without Reference in Large Language Models
sources.role: Argues that conceptual-role relations may constitute important aspects of meaning; used as a strong counterposition, not consensus.

sources.author: Kenneth Li et al.
sources.title: Emergent World Representations: Exploring a Sequence Model Trained on a Synthetic Task
sources.role: Finds an internal Othello board representation and uses interventions to affect model output in a bounded domain.

sources.author: Wes Gurnee and Max Tegmark
sources.title: Language Models Represent Space and Time
sources.role: Reports robust linear spatial and temporal representations across several datasets.

sources.author: Danny Driess et al.
sources.title: PaLM-E: An Embodied Multimodal Language Model
sources.role: Shows a model integrating text, vision, continuous state estimates, and robotic tasks, relevant to grounding beyond text.

sources.author: Kyle Mahowald et al.
sources.title: Dissociating Language and Thought in Large Language Models
sources.role: Separates formal linguistic competence from functional language use in the world.

sources.author: Melanie Mitchell and David C. Krakauer
sources.title: The Debate over Understanding in AI's Large Language Models
sources.role: Maps the strongest positions and motivates multiple modes of understanding and mechanism-sensitive tests.

sources.author: Emily M. Bender and Alexander Koller; Yonatan Bisk et al.
sources.title: Form, meaning, and experiential grounding research program
sources.role: A register grouping only for cross-claim opposition; the article must cite A06 and A07 separately.

sources.author: Atticus Geiger et al.
sources.title: Causal Abstraction: A Theoretical Foundation for Mechanistic Interpretability
sources.role: Formalizes causal abstraction and intervention-based faithfulness for interpreting model mechanisms.

sources.author: Yusuke Sakai, Hidetaka Kamigaito, and Taro Watanabe
sources.title: Revisiting Compositional Generalization Capability of Large Language Models Considering Instruction Following Ability
sources.role: Tests ordered concept composition across 36 models and identifies persistent pattern and diversity limits.

sources.author: Joshua Engels et al.
sources.title: Not All Language Model Features Are Linear
sources.role: Reports interpretable multidimensional circular features and intervention evidence in bounded tasks.

sources.author: Metin Ismayilzada et al.
sources.title: Evaluating Morphological Compositional Generalization in Large Language Models
sources.role: Finds sharp limitations in systematic morphological productivity under novel roots and increasing complexity.

sources.author: Guangxiang Zhao et al.
sources.title: Large Language Models Badly Generalize across Option Length, Problem Types, and Irrelevant Noun Replacements
sources.role: Provides controlled content-preserving perturbation tests exposing severe shortcut sensitivity.

sources.author: Rylan Schaeffer, Brando Miranda, and Sanmi Koyejo
sources.title: Are Emergent Abilities of Large Language Models a Mirage?
sources.role: Shows how discontinuous metrics can manufacture apparent emergence from smooth underlying changes.

sources.author: Wes Gurnee et al.
sources.title: Verbalizable Representations Form a Global Workspace in Language Models
sources.role: Reports functional global-workspace-like properties; may be discussed only as unreviewed evidence about access-like function, never as proof of phenomenal consciousness.

next_validation: Verify the exact Arabic wording and relevant passages in Tafsir al-Tabari, al-Qurtubi, al-Razi, Ibn Ashur, and al-Raghib.
Resolve A15 by removing the grouped pseudo-source before publication and citing A06/A07 separately.
Confirm publication status and final bibliographic metadata for every 2025 paper.
Select at least one strong empirical counterexample for each matrix layer.
Build reciprocal source-to-claim support arrays in the publication-grade claims.json.
Keep A22 outside the central conclusion unless peer-reviewed evidence and expert review justify a later update.
